007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SummaryParams;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * Sample for summarizing content with a Select AI profile.
019 *
020 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, obtain a
021 * {@link Profile} object, call
022 * {@link Profile#summarize(String, String, String, String, SummaryParams)}, and
023 * print the summary response.</p>
024 *
025 * <p>This sample can summarize inline content or content referenced by
026 * {@code SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_LOCATION_URI}. For URI-based summarization, ensure
027 * {@code SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_CREDENTIAL_NAME} names a database credential that
028 * can read the referenced object-storage URI. The object URI, credential,
029 * network access, and provider/profile settings must be configured before
030 * running URI-based summarization.</p>
031 *
032 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
033 * <ul>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
036 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
038 *   <li>SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_CONTENT or SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_LOCATION_URI</li>
039 * </ul>
040 *
041 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
042 * <ul>
043 *   <li>SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_CREDENTIAL_NAME - credential name for external content access.</li>
044 *   <li>SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_LOCATION_URI - external content URI.</li>
045 *   <li>SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_PROMPT - summary instruction.</li>
046 *   <li>SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_MIN_WORDS</li>
047 *   <li>SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_MAX_WORDS</li>
048 *   <li>SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_STYLE - {@code paragraph} or {@code list}.</li>
049 *   <li>SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_CHUNK_PROCESSING_METHOD -
050 *       {@code iterative_refinement} or {@code map_reduce}.</li>
051 *   <li>SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_EXTRACTIVENESS_LEVEL -
052 *       {@code high}, {@code medium}, or {@code low}.</li>
053 * </ul>
054 *
055 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
056 * <pre>{@code
057 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
058 * }</pre>
059 *
060 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
061 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
062 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
063 * <pre>{@code
064 * mvn clean install
065 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
066 * }</pre>
067 *
068 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
069 * <pre>{@code
070 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/SummarizeProfileSample.java
071 * }</pre>
072 *
073 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
074 * <pre>{@code
075 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.SummarizeProfileSample
076 * }</pre>
077 *
078 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
079 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
080 * and diagnostics.</p>
081 */
082public final class SummarizeProfileSample {
083    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SummarizeProfileSample.class);
084
085    private SummarizeProfileSample() {
086    }
087
088    public static void main(String[] args) {
089        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
090        String content = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_CONTENT");
091        String credentialName = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_CREDENTIAL_NAME");
092        String locationUri = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_LOCATION_URI");
093        String userPrompt = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_PROMPT");
094        SummaryParams typedParams = buildSummaryParams();
095        validateSummarizeInput(content, credentialName, locationUri);
096
097        try {
098            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
099            Profile profile = selectAI.profile(profileName);
100            String summary = profile.summarize(content, credentialName, locationUri, userPrompt, typedParams);
101
102            System.out.printf("Summary response:%n%s%n", valueOrEmpty(summary));
103        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
104            LOGGER.error("Failed to summarize content for Select AI profile '{}'.", profileName, e);
105        }
106    }
107
108    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
109        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
110                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
111                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
112                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
113                .build();
114
115        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
116    }
117
118    private static SummaryParams buildSummaryParams() {
119        if (!hasAnyTypedParam()) {
120            return null;
121        }
122        SummaryParams.Builder builder = SummaryParams.builder();
123        applyOptionalInteger(builder::minWords, "SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_MIN_WORDS");
124        applyOptionalInteger(builder::maxWords, "SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_MAX_WORDS");
125        applyOptionalStyle(builder, "SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_STYLE");
126        applyOptionalChunkProcessingMethod(builder, "SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_CHUNK_PROCESSING_METHOD");
127        applyOptionalExtractivenessLevel(builder, "SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_EXTRACTIVENESS_LEVEL");
128        return builder.build();
129    }
130
131    private static boolean hasAnyTypedParam() {
132        return optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_MIN_WORDS") != null
133                || optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_MAX_WORDS") != null
134                || optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_STYLE") != null
135                || optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_CHUNK_PROCESSING_METHOD") != null
136                || optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_EXTRACTIVENESS_LEVEL") != null;
137    }
138
139    private static void applyOptionalInteger(IntegerAttributeSetter setter, String envName) {
140        String value = optionalEnv(envName);
141        if (value != null) {
142            setter.set(Integer.valueOf(value));
143        }
144    }
145
146    private static void applyOptionalStyle(SummaryParams.Builder builder, String envName) {
147        String value = optionalEnv(envName);
148        if (value != null) {
149            builder.summaryStyle(SummaryParams.Style.valueOf(value.trim().toUpperCase()));
150        }
151    }
152
153    private static void applyOptionalChunkProcessingMethod(SummaryParams.Builder builder, String envName) {
154        String value = optionalEnv(envName);
155        if (value != null) {
156            builder.chunkProcessingMethod(SummaryParams.ChunkProcessingMethod.valueOf(
157                    value.trim().toUpperCase()));
158        }
159    }
160
161    private static void applyOptionalExtractivenessLevel(SummaryParams.Builder builder, String envName) {
162        String value = optionalEnv(envName);
163        if (value != null) {
164            builder.extractivenessLevel(SummaryParams.ExtractivenessLevel.valueOf(value.trim().toUpperCase()));
165        }
166    }
167
168    private static void validateSummarizeInput(String content, String credentialName, String locationUri) {
169        if ((content == null || content.isBlank()) && (locationUri == null || locationUri.isBlank())) {
170            throw new IllegalStateException(
171                    "Set SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_CONTENT or SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_LOCATION_URI before running this sample");
172        }
173        if (locationUri != null && !locationUri.isBlank()
174                && (credentialName == null || credentialName.isBlank())) {
175            throw new IllegalStateException(
176                    "Set SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_CREDENTIAL_NAME when SELECTAI_SUMMARIZE_LOCATION_URI is provided");
177        }
178    }
179
180    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
181        String value = System.getenv(name);
182        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
183            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
184        }
185        return value;
186    }
187
188    private static String optionalEnv(String name) {
189        String value = System.getenv(name);
190        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
191    }
192
193    private static String valueOrEmpty(String value) {
194        return value == null ? "" : value;
195    }
196
197    @FunctionalInterface
198    private interface IntegerAttributeSetter {
199        void set(Integer value);
200    }
201
202}
